correctness.rationale: For each finite N>=2 the lossy semigroup has dark complement to cyclic span of the upper-rim trap. Imaginary-part eigenvalue argument yields asymptotic capture rank R independent of gamma>0; mixed input gives R/(3N+1). With B the rim-by-hub magnetic incidence matrix, hub Gram T=B*B has positive simple spectrum for generic flux and detector overlap cannot cancel two real neighboring gauged Jacobi components. At zero flux the signless path eigenmodes have detector overlap proportional to sin(jkπ/(N+1)), exactly gcd(j,N+1)-1 invisible positive modes, giving 2N-2gcd(j,N+1)+3. At phi=pi Gram is diagonal with endpoint energy2 and bulk energy4, yielding two positive pairs for end site and one for interior. Zero-energy visible spectral support is one in all cases. Independent direct Hermitian spectral eigenspace grouping for N=2..9 and each detector/three fluxes verified all ranks. Finite tests not used as infinite proof.
